description: Capability for Lare Terminal generic plugin windows (Plugin Slice 1, label: 'plugin-*'). Grants core:default so plugin-window.js can invoke take_window_content / close_self via IPC and use the event API (core:event: emit plugin:ui-event / plugin:window-closed, listen for plugin:update / plugin:close). Grants core:window:allow-start-dragging for the chromeless, transparent titlebar drag region. Global-shortcut and clipboard permissions are intentionally NOT included.
